title: Reset application settings to factory defaults
summary: Delete all custom configuration settings for an application, effectively resetting it to its initial state.

steps.explain: Delete all stored defaults for a specific application. This removes all custom settings and preferences.

placeholders.name: APPLICATION
placeholders.description: The bundle identifier or name of the app

warnings: This action deletes ALL custom settings for the app. You cannot undo this.
The app will behave as if it were freshly installed.

rollback.explain: There is no command to restore deleted defaults. You must manually reconfigure the app or restore from a backup.
